title: Epic 2: Matching logic with tests (TDD)
description: Pure functions parseQuery/matches. Hardcoded chips: 4K(2160p,4k,uhd) 1080p(1080p) HDR(hdr,'dolby vision', whole-word dv) Dub(dub,'dual audio') GB flag (literal). 4K/1080p OR'd within resolution group; groups and text AND'd. Exports under Node only.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes: includes, excludes, mixed, empty/whitespace, case, flag, DVDRip not HDR, Multi Subs not Dub, 4K+1080p OR.

title: Epic 7: Settings integration
description: Wire settings into the app: bootstrap that registers the schema (tolerating the already-registered rejection after Ctrl+R), reads keys with per-key catch (first getSetting rejects by design), and rebuilds chips live on onSettingsSaved. Includes defensive re-save of terms containing quote/angle chars (user approved).
acceptance_criteria: Settings modal shows toggles+inputs; changes apply live; no-API fallback still mounts default chips; browser test covers live update

title: Epic 4: Per-show filter memory
description: In-memory state keyed by meta id from #/detail/{type}/{id}/... Survives episode change and player->back; cleared on other title or leaving detail/player. No disk persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Manually verified: survives S1E1->S1E2 and player->back; cleared after home and reopen.
notes: Implemented (route key tests in test/route.test.js, wiring covered in browser-tests). STILL TO DO: manual check in real app.

title: Epic 3: Filter bar and chips in page
description: MutationObserver+hashchange, class-prefix selectors, input+chips+count above list, display:none rows re-checked on every mutation (React reuses rows), debounce, key events isolated, Esc clears, no-matches line, graceful warn if markup changed.
acceptance_criteria: Manually verified on a movie and an anime episode with Torrentio + another addon.
notes: Implemented + verified in headless Chromium against a fixture with Stremio's real class names (npm run test:browser, 26 checks). STILL TO DO: manual check in real Stremio Enhanced (movie + anime episode, Torrentio + another addon).

title: Epic 6: Configurable chip model
description: Make the filter chips user-configurable in Stremio Enhanced plugin settings: per-chip enable/disable toggle plus editable comma-separated match terms, ~ prefix for whole-word. Adds a 720p chip to the defaults (delivered first, standalone).
acceptance_criteria: Chip identity (id/label/group) fixed; enabled + terms editable; 720p default chip in the res group; unit tests cover resolveChips/buildSchema/matches

title: Add 720p chip to defaults

acceptance_criteria: npm test and npm run test:browser pass; fresh bar shows 6 chips; 720p ORs with 4K/1080p
